json.__comment: all items that the crystallization enchantment for the galena guantlet can use.

all items pulled or pushed by magnets. Every convention-tag reference below is optional, and each is preceded by the vanilla items it would have contributed. Fabric API's convention-tags module ships a DIFFERENT subset of these on every build it has ever made — 1.20.1's pin has no c:ingots/iron, 1.20.5's and 1.21's have no c:nuggets/iron, none of them has ever had c:ores/iron — and a required reference to a tag that does not exist makes the WHOLE tag fail to load, taking alexscaves:galena_gauntlet_crystallization_items down with it. Optional references keep every other mod's iron on the loaders that do define these, while vanilla's own iron stays magnetic everywhere.

values.__comment: Fabric API ships no c:ores/iron item tag, and this mod only ever contributed its galena ore to the BLOCK side of it — hence the two lines above, which are what that reference is worth on a loader that has no such tag. Optional so the loaders that do define it still bring every other mod's iron ore along.
